title: known positive: constant cache key on a dependency directory

files..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: CI
on:
  push:
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.npm
          key: npm-cache
      - run: npm ci

title: similar negative: key includes hashFiles of the lockfile

files..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: CI
on:
  push:
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.npm
          key: npm-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
      - run: npm ci

title: boundary: Maven jars (~/.m2) are portable across operating systems, so a key without an OS part is not reported

files..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: CI
on:
  push:
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2
          key: m2-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
